title: Air Station Kodiak Rescue Dec 12th, 2022: The Crew Perspective
description: Coast Guard personnel recount their response to a case from Dec. 22, 2022, in which an MH-60T Jayhawk helicopter air crew from U.S. Coast Guard Air Station Kodiak, Alaska, located and hoisted three men and dog who were stranded on rocks in high-wind conditions near Esther Island, Alaska, May 1, 2023.  Coast Guard Sector Anchorage command center watch standers received the initial distress call from the survivors aboard the 45-foot fishing vessel Privateer over VHF-FM channel 16 at approximately 11:55 a.m., who stated they had donned survival suits and were preparing to abandon their vessel, which was getting slammed against rocks. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Lt. Scott Kellerman)

up getting ready to go out and do a
training mission . So I was already
dressed out . We just heard the call
and already knew then to switch our job ,

already going to take . And the initial

in the middle of the channel . And then
throughout the next couple of hours ,

was very close to making contact with
the rocks . They anchor overboard and
they were able to drag it until it
caught on rocks under the water .
Finally got the confirmation that they
were at anchor and they weren't going

And they were an extremely beneficial

we were using the , using the

without having time for normal
